title: RudderStack Failures by Destination
app: RudderStack delivery and failed-events metrics via the RudderStack API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=rudderstack:delivery status="failed" OR status="aborted"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by destination_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts RudderStack failures grouped by destination so operators immediately see which specific destinations are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'RudderStack is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest RudderStack failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical destinations.
visualization: Table of destination by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of RudderStack are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
